_about: Test trips for the recommendation engine. 'relevant' = the active cars a knowledgeable rental agent would suggest, written down BEFORE running the engine, from the fleet data (ids: 1 Wagon R hatchback 5 seats Rs 5,000; 2 BMW 5 Series sedan Rs 10,000; 3 Audi Q8 SUV Rs 10,000; 4 Nissan Kicks SUV Rs 7,000; 5 Nissan GT-R coupe 4 seats Rs 10,000; 6 Nissan Sunny sedan Rs 5,000; 7 Toyota Fortuner 7-seat rugged SUV Rs 10,000; 8 Vitara Brezza SUV Rs 7,000). 'top1' = the car that must rank first. 'min_seats' / 'max_budget' = hard constraints every returned car must meet (budget allows the engine's 10% tolerance).
